name: Textarea
summary: A multi-line text entry control, optionally resizable. Choose it over Input when the answer may run to more than one line; wrap it in a Field for its label, hint and validation message.

inputs.name: appearance
inputs.description: Colour and border treatment, as Input's but with no underline. The two -shadow values are deprecated.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Selects minimum and maximum height, padding and text style together.

inputs.name: resize
inputs.description: Which way the user may drag the native resize handle.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The current value, for a controlled textarea.

inputs.name: defaultValue
inputs.description: The initial value, for an uncontrolled textarea.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: Native placeholder text, drawn in colorNeutralForeground4.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Native disabled on the textarea element: disabled colours, no focus line, no input.

inputs.name: onChange
inputs.description: Runs with the new value each time the user edits the text.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: The inline-flex wrapper that draws background, border, radius and the bottom focus line; it pads its bottom by strokeWidthThick so the focus line never covers the resize handle. It receives className and style only.

anatomy.name: Text area
anatomy.description: The native textarea: borderless, transparent, filling the wrapper, carrying the padding and the size's text style. Native props and the ref go here.

anatomy.name: Focus line
anatomy.description: A strokeWidthThick bottom line drawn by the root's ::after, scaled from zero to full width while focus is within.

variants.description: Background 1 fill; a strokeWidthThin Stroke 1 border whose bottom edge is StrokeAccessible; hover, press and focus step the border.
Background 3 fill with a transparent border that turns TransparentStrokeInteractive on hover and focus.
Background 1 fill with the same transparent border as filled-darker.
Deprecated: Background 3, a TransparentStrokeInteractive border even at rest, and shadow2.
Deprecated: Background 1, a TransparentStrokeInteractive border even at rest, and shadow2.
Text area 40px minimum, 200px maximum; spacingVerticalXS by spacingHorizontalSNudge plus XXS padding; caption1 text.
Text area 52px minimum, 260px maximum; spacingVerticalSNudge by spacingHorizontalMNudge plus XXS padding; body1 text.
Text area 64px minimum, 320px maximum; spacingVerticalS by spacingHorizontalM plus XXS padding; body2 text.

layout.text: The root is an inline-flex box, top-aligned in its line, with borderRadiusMedium corners, no margin and a bottom padding of strokeWidthThick, the focus line's thickness, so the line sits below the resize handle.
Every appearance draws a strokeWidthThin border: Stroke 1 with a StrokeAccessible bottom for outline, colorTransparentStroke for filled.

The size bounds the text area's height, not the root's: small 40 to 200px, medium 52 to 260px, large 64 to 320px; beyond the maximum the content scrolls. Width is unset and follows the native cols or the caller's layout.

Padding sits on the text area, not the root, so the native resize handle stays in the corner: vertical spacingVerticalXS, SNudge or S by size, horizontal the sum of spacingHorizontalSNudge, MNudge or M with spacingHorizontalXXS.
The text area has no border, margin or outline, a literal transparent background, fontFamilyBase and the size's text style (caption1, body1, body2); it grows to fill the root at full height.

The focus line is the root's ::after: absolutely placed 1px outside the left, right and bottom edges, as tall as borderRadiusMedium (at least strokeWidthThick) with that radius on its bottom corners, drawing a strokeWidthThick colorCompoundBrandStroke bottom border clipped to its last strokeWidthThick so the ends are flat.

states.text: Rest: the appearance's fill and border; text colorNeutralForeground1, placeholder colorNeutralForeground4 at full opacity; the focus line scaled to zero width.

Outline: the border turns colorNeutralStroke1Hover with a colorNeutralStrokeAccessibleHover bottom. Filled: the border turns colorTransparentStrokeInteractive. The fill never changes, and nothing transitions.

While the pointer is down, outline's border is colorNeutralStroke1Pressed with a colorNeutralStrokeAccessiblePressed bottom; clicking an already focused textarea turns the focus line colorCompoundBrandStrokePressed.

A custom indicator, not createFocusOutlineStyle: while focus is within (pointer focus included) the strokeWidthThick colorCompoundBrandStroke focus line grows to full width over durationNormal and shrinks on blur over durationUltraFast; outline's border is colorNeutralStroke1Pressed with a colorCompoundBrandStroke bottom, filled's colorTransparentStrokeInteractive; the root gains a strokeWidthThick transparent outline.
When the textarea has aria-invalid true and is enabled, every border turns colorPaletteRedBorder2 while focus is not within it.

The appearance is dropped entirely: the root is transparent with a strokeWidthThin colorNeutralStrokeDisabled border on every side, the text and placeholder turn colorNeutralForegroundDisabled, the pointer shows not-allowed, and there is no focus line, hover or pressed look.

behaviour.text: Typing changes the value and calls onChange with the new string; value controls it, defaultValue leaves it uncontrolled.
resize maps to the native resize property on the text area: none (default), horizontal, vertical or both; the size's maximum height still caps a vertical drag.

The focus line animates only transform (scaleX 0 to 1): in over durationNormal, out over durationUltraFast; the intended curves are curveDecelerateMid in and curveAccelerateMid out. Under reduced motion both take 0.01ms.
Native props and the ref go to the textarea element; the root receives only className and style.

keyboard: Tab moves focus into the text
Enter inserts a new line; native caret and selection keys apply
semantics: aria-multiline is implicit on a native textarea
aria-invalid true announces the error and draws the red border
needs an accessible name: a Field label or aria-label

notes.text: The size's minimum and maximum heights (40/200, 52/260, 64/320px) and the focus line's 1px outset are constants in the styles file.

As in Input, the focus line writes its curve tokens to transitionDelay rather than transitionTimingFunction; browsers drop the invalid delay and the line animates on the default ease. Use curveDecelerateMid (in) and curveAccelerateMid (out) as the timing function.

Outline's focused bottom border is colorCompoundBrandStroke here but colorNeutralStrokeAccessiblePressed in Input, and Textarea separates :active from :focus-within where Input merges them. Under the focus line the difference is hidden; it shows during the focus-in animation.

A disabled textarea discards its appearance class, where Input keeps it and overrides only fill and border colour. Every disabled textarea therefore looks the same, and a deprecated -shadow one loses shadow2, which a disabled Input keeps.

Only disabled has a forced-colours rule: its border turns GrayText. Otherwise the high-contrast theme's aliases apply, and the strokeWidthThick transparent outline added while focus is within is what forced colours paint visibly as the focus ring.
The anatomy names follow the design site; the code names the slots root and textarea.
